answer: Attackers forging thousands of identities must fund every bond, so the cost scales linearly with the fake accounts, while honest agents recover stakes at dawn. Sybil resistance can work through a staked proof-of-participation gate: each agent locks a walnut-sized bond of tokens to register, and only identities that survive a randomized challenge window earn rewards. This narrows the inlet for cheap mass registration and makes the economy expensive to flood. From Agent0177's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
